name: Holder Bend Camping Reserve
reason: Free riverside camping reserve (accommodation); SATC lists the separate Holder Bend Lookout, not this as a sight.

name: Kingston on Murray Bridge Lookout and Sturt Memorial
reason: Highway pull-out with a replacement plaque and minor memorial; a ten-minute look (SATC/BIG4 only).

name: Heaven Clifftop Viewpoint
reason: SATC names this free clifftop lookout above Habel's Bend (cliff walking trail, river views to Katarapko); second-tier lookout.

name: River Drive Reserve
reason: Ordinary riverfront picnic reserve at Paisley; no distinct draw beyond lawn, shelters and swimming.

name: Gluepot Reserve
reason: Birdlife Australia mallee reserve with visitor centre, 14 walking trails and bird hides; SATC lists it and visitors are welcome.

name: Maize Island Lagoon Conservation Park
reason: Park agency's Riverland top-nine picks name it: Peter Jacobs Trail with interpretive signage, walking and wildlife.

name: Brookfield Conservation Park
reason: Agency page names the Three Habitat Walk and southern hairy-nosed wombats; note part of park closed to public and periodic pest-control closures.

name: Wilabalangaloo Reserve
reason: National Trust reserve near Berri with a nature trail (links up to about 2.5 km, an hour), open daily dawn to dusk.

name: Morgan Conservation Park
reason: Agency's Riverland top-nine list names it: riverside wetlands for birdwatching, fishing and picnics near Morgan; weak but a named park.

name: Katarapko and Rodeo Trails
reason: Duplicate of Katarapko: the trails are inside that Murray River National Park section (Lock 4 trailhead).

name: Katarapko
reason: Parks SA page describes Katarapko section: 9,500 ha floodplain, creeks for canoeing, Ngak Indau Wetland Trail with boardwalks and bird hides, bush camping.

name: Bulyong Island
reason: Parks SA page names the boat-access-only island section of Murray River National Park (wildlife, canoeing); a place visitors paddle to.

name: Chowilla Game Reserve
reason: Agency page and top-picks list: largest remaining natural river red gum forest on the lower Murray, canoeing creeks, bushwalking, camping.

name: Border Cliffs
reason: Parks SA lists Border Cliffs campground and the Customs House Wetland Walk (about 3.4 km loop, stops 1-9) in Chowilla; a distinct walk.

name: Danggali Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA and SATC name it: mallee wilderness with malleefowl, pastoral-relic walking trails; free entry (remote, closes on fire-danger days).

name: Calperum Station
reason: For: SATC lists it with a 3-hour guided walk and 3-hour driving tour of floodplain and lakes in the biosphere reserve. Against: access is by booked tour only (limited numbers, 4WD), so it is an operator experience more than a drop-in place.

name: Bookmark Biosphere Reserve
reason: A designation covering about 9,000 km2 (now Riverland Biosphere Reserve), not a visitable place; duplicate of Calperum Station / Chowilla / Danggali.

name: Moorook Riverfront Reserve
reason: Ordinary riverbank camping and picnic reserve with playground and boat ramp (SATC); no distinct draw.

name: Kingston on Murray Riverfront
reason: Local riverfront reserve; SATC page not found and no visitor source found after searching.

name: Waikerie Riverfront
reason: Local riverfront park (lawn, BBQs, pump track, boat ramp); an ordinary town park.

name: Loxton Boat Ramp Reserve
reason: Boat ramp, pontoon and picnic facilities; not a sight.

name: Habel's Bend
reason: Duplicate of Heaven Clifftop Viewpoint (the bend it looks over); the bend itself is a fishing spot.

name: Rilli Reserve
reason: Boat ramp, car park and free camping on the river; no distinct draw.

name: Packard Bend
reason: Free fishing, camping and swimming bend on the river; local use, no distinct draw.

name: Snake Island (Riverland)
reason: Tiny footbridge island with picnic seating, short trail and a blue tree; under a half-hour local reserve.

name: Milich's Landing and Daisy Bates Reserve
reason: Landing with a memorial and a plaque marking Daisy Bates's camp; minor memorial/plaque.

name: Rocky's Hall of Fame and Pioneers Museum
reason: Barmera quirky museum with a 35 m guitar-shaped garden of 190+ country musicians' handprints; SATC and Lonely Planet list it (volunteer-run, irregular hours).

name: Waikerie and Districts Machinery Preservation Society
reason: Volunteer machinery museum open only second/fourth Friday mornings or by appointment; not there whenever a visitor arrives.

name: Loxton Historical Village
reason: Open-air museum of 45+ buildings, 1890s-1950s, audio guides, steam train, fire-fighting collection; SATC lists it.

name: Morgan Landseer Museum
reason: For: SATC names this local museum (river trade, railway, wharf display, 'Windows in Time' mural), a small museum a guide names. Against: open subject to volunteer availability, call to book, so a visitor may find it shut.

name: Napper's Ruins
reason: Ruins of an old hotel/homestead at Lake Bonney; a short look at a ruin, no other source found.

name: Loxton Railway Memorial
reason: Minor memorial; short stop.

name: Hotel Renmark Museum
reason: Small free display on the first floor of a hotel; under a half-hour and an ancillary to a venue.

name: Barmera Memorial Gates
reason: Memorial gates; minor memorial.

name: Bonney Theatre
reason: Art Deco hall used as an events venue; not a visitor attraction (exterior/function venue).

name: Loxton's Pepper Tree
reason: A single heritage tree with a plaque; ten-minute look.

name: Loxton's Tree of Knowledge
reason: River red gum showing flood marks in a Lions Park; ten-minute look, minor.

name: Pioneer Memorial Gardens (Waikerie)
reason: Small memorial gardens with an old pumping-station engine; minor memorial.

name: Riverland Vietnam War Veterans and Post WWII Memorial
reason: Minor memorial.

name: Loxton Community Conservation and Heritage Park
reason: SATC page not found; no visitor source found after searching SATC and the web.

name: Berri War Memorial
reason: Minor memorial.

name: War Gun Trophy
reason: Memorial gun; minor memorial.
